description: Sunita hires Ramesh to paint her 2BHK. They agree the work, the amount (24,000 with material), the advance (8,000 on the first morning), the dates (Monday to Friday), and a late penalty (500 a day). They move from the advance straight to the dates and never say when the balance is paid.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon. Sharma ji ne aapka number diya tha, painting ke liye.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji madam, namaste. Sharma ji ne bataya tha. Boliye, kya kaam hai?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Poora flat paint karwana hai - dono bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur balcony ki grill bhi.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya sirf walls?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi seelan hai, wahan putty bhi lagegi.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe pehle putty aur primer, phir do coat. Paint kaunsa lagwana hai, normal emulsion ya premium wala?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emulsion theek hai. Material aap laoge ya main mangwaun?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tension nahi leni. Labour aur material mila ke bata deta hoon.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam bhi hai... labour material sab mila ke 28 hazaar lagega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar 20 mein poora ghar hua tha.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Chaliye aapke liye 25 kar deta hoon, isse kam nahi hoga.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahiye.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, material, putty, sab ismein.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Done. Aur advance kitna chahiye aapko?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Material lana padega na madam, to 8 hazaar advance de dijiye, kaam shuru karne se pehle.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shuru karoge us din subah GPay kar dungi.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji bilkul, chalega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle hafte mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon. Do ladke aur lagaunga saath mein.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Aur khatam kab tak hoga?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru, Friday shaam tak poora finish.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jayenge, uske baad nahi chalega.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Pakka madam, Friday shaam tak. Aap befikar rahiye.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli baar ek contractor ne do hafte latka diya tha.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Aisa nahi hoga ji. Phir bhi agar late hua to har din ka 500 rupaye kaat lena aap.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakhna.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam, zubaan di hai.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam, 9 baje pahunch jaunga. Dhanyavaad.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko milte hain. Bye.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Namaste madam.

expected_note: Each entry is a moment the Judge should speak. after_line is the line that makes it true: the Judge speaks in the pause after it. by_line is the last line after which speaking still counts as on time. modes lists the JUDGE_MODE values in which the entry applies. The transcript is a call with no Judge on it, so nobody answers the first question and the item is still open at wrap-up.
